info.title: regelhet: FSC voor Burgers
info.description: The citizen's service of the regelhet server for an app, after the werkversie of FSC voor Burgers (https://docs.fsc4b.nl/specs/protocol/). An app starts a session with CreateSession (section 4.3.4): POST /fsc4b/session/v1/challenge, then POST /fsc4b/session/v1/complete. Every request to the citizen's service carries the session token in the Authorization header and a body that is a compact JWE (alg dir, enc A256GCM) under the session's AES key, holding a JSON object. Every answer of the citizen's service is a JWE under the same key, holding the JSON answer, an error included ({"fout": "..."}), beside the HTTP status; only a 401 (no live session under the token, or a body that does not decrypt under its key) and a 500 while reading the session are plain JSON.

post.description: No body. The answer is a compact JWS (ES256) signed by the organization's key from the Stelseldocument, with the claims sub ("challenge"), nonce (16 random bytes, base64) and ephemeral_organization_ec_public_key (base64 DER of a P-256 key). The nonce is valid for one minute and can be answered once.

post.summary: The answer to a challenge, for a session

encrypted_challenge_result.description: The Verifiable Presentation (section 4.3.4.1) as a compact JWE, alg ECDH-ES, enc A256GCM, to the ephemeral key of the challenge. Its session_aes_key holds 32 bytes, base64.

200.description: The session token, as a compact JWE (alg dir, enc A256GCM) under the session_aes_key of the presentation

post.summary: The forms, with what the UI spec says of their fields
The records about the citizen of the session, in every cell
A submission by the citizen of the session, for themself
post.description: Decrypted, the body is a submission as POST /api/indieningen takes it: { "velden": { ... }, "artikel"?: "...", "op"?: "<record id>", "idempotency_key"?: "..." }. The idempotency key sits inside the encryption, so it is authenticated: sent again, the request answers as the first time and records nothing. The Idempotency-Key header is not read here. The login field of the case is filled with the BSN of the credential; a submission that names it itself is refused (422).

post.summary: Why a decision of the citizen's own dossier came out so
post.description: Decrypted, the body is { "id": "<id of a decision>" } and the answer is the explanation GET /api/dossier/waarom/{id} gives. A decision outside the citizen's dossier answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

post.summary: The source data the executor holds about the citizen of the session, signed
post.description: Decrypted, the body is {}; a BSN in it is not read. The answers are those the case file names under uitgeven, each an answer of the executor's cell (answers in its cel.yaml) that takes the login field of the case as its one required parameter; the server fills it with the BSN of the session. Without uitgeven, antwoorden is empty. Each answer is computed on today by the server's clock. The decrypted answer is { "ondertekend": "<compact JWS>", "gegevens": { ... } }: ondertekend is a JWS (ES256) under the organization's key from the Stelseldocument, and gegevens is its payload, for an app that does not verify. A waarde of null means the cell gives no answer (it is silent), not false. bij_aanvraag names the facts that only come after an application, such as an advice another party still has to give: those are missing because they do not exist yet. The JWS carries no exp or aud: it records what the organization handed out on peildatum, for whoever the citizen shows it to.

200.description: A compact JWE (alg dir, enc A256GCM) under the session key, holding a Gegevens object

post.summary: The timeline of an application of the citizen's own dossier
post.description: Decrypted, the body is { "id": "<id of a record of the dossier>" } and the answer is the timeline GET /api/dossier/tijdlijn/{id} gives: the records of the application that record belongs to, within the citizen's dossier, and what comes next. A record outside the citizen's dossier answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

get.summary: The case as a bundle, to compute on locally
get.description: Without a session: the case is no personal data. Plain JSON, { "<path>": "<text>" }, every file of the source the server runs, by its path in the source: the case under casussen/, the regelwerken under regulation/, the cells with their reductions under cells/, and the UI spec as ui_spec.yaml. It is the bestanden of a source (packages/poc-chronolexografie/src/bundel.rs, Bron) that the kern loads with bundel::uit_bron, as the server loads it. The signed source data carry its hash (bundel_hash). A manifest may make several cases; the one the server runs is the one gegevens names under casus.

get.summary: How the screens of the process look
get.description: Without a session: what the web front shows anyone (GET /api/uiterlijk), and nothing else of the configuration. accentkleur is a theme of the NLDD design system, or null for the default; titel is the title of the bar; organisatie is the organisation the process belongs to, { naam, url }, or null.

200.description: Per service its versions and their URLs

ondertekend.description: A compact JWS (ES256) under the organization's key, whose payload is gegevens

bundel_hash.description: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bundle GET /fsc4b/regelwerken gives: per path in ascending byte order, the decimal byte length of the path, ':', the path, the decimal byte length of its text, ':' and the text, all UTF-8, concatenated without separators. {"a.yaml": "x"} hashes the bytes 6:a.yaml1:x. An app checks the bundle against it before it computes on it.

peildatum.description: The day the answers are computed on, by the server's clock (the test clock in test mode)

cel.description: The executor's cell, which gave the answers

regelwerken.description: The regelwerk versions the answers were computed under

antwoorden.description: Per answer name (cel.yaml answers) its value and where it came from

waarde.description: The value; null when the cell gives no answer

parameters.description: What the answer was asked with: the login field of the case and the BSN of the session, such as { "bsn_aanvrager": "999990032" }. Ask the same of the cell (Cell::give_answer, or brongegevens in the kern) to compute it again.

records.description: The records of the citizen's dossier, in every cell, as POST /fsc4b/burger/v1/dossier gives them under grammen: what the answers rest on, to replay locally

bij_aanvraag.description: The facts that only come after an application (bij_aanvraag of the case)

taak.description: What the fact is called while it has yet to come

SessionToken.name: Authorization
SessionToken.description: The session token from /fsc4b/session/v1/complete, bare or after "Bearer ".

application/jose.description: A compact JWE (alg dir, enc A256GCM) under the session key, holding {}.

Encrypted.description: A compact JWE (alg dir, enc A256GCM) under the session key, holding the JSON answer

NoSession.description: No live session under the token, or a body that does not decrypt under its key

NotAccepted.description: The presentation is not accepted; the server's log says why
